title: Ultra-high-end commercial product advert
prompt:
Ultra-high-end commercial product advertisement poster for GoPro HERO action camera, 
shot in the style of a tier-1 sports marketing agency. Hero product: GoPro HERO camera 
floating at center frame, photorealistic with precise button placement, accurate lens 
geometry, water droplets catching dramatic backlight, blue LED accent glow. Background: 
mountain biker launching off a cliff edge at golden hour, motion blur on wheels, dust 
particles catching light, stormy cinematic sky with god rays breaking through clouds. 
Camera HUD overlay elements integrated into composition — REC indicator, GPS, battery, 
4K/120fps badge. Right side vertical feature callout cards with frosted glass morphism 
panels: HyperSmooth 6.0, Waterproof 33ft, Voice Control, Live Streaming 1080p. 
Typography: massive condensed white sans-serif headline "CAPTURE THE IMPOSSIBLE" 
with subtle texture and slight weathering. Bottom CTA bar with teal/cyan accent. 
Overall grade: dark moody desaturated with warm orange sky contrast. 
Shot on Hasselblad, retouched by Erik Almas. --ar 2:3 --style raw --v 6.1

Ultra-high-end commercial product advertisement poster for DJI Osmo Action 5 Pro, 
created by a tier-1 creative agency. Hero product: DJI Osmo Action camera floating 
at slight angle, photorealistic with accurate button layout, precise lens geometry, 
dual front-and-back screen visible, subtle condensation on body, clean matte black 
finish with DJI logo sharp and legible. Background: professional cinematographer 
on a rocky coastal cliff at blue hour, crashing waves below, mist catching 
cool ambient light, long exposure water blur suggesting stillness within chaos. 
Camera stabilisation visualised as subtle floating grid lines or motion path 
trails emanating from camera body. Integrated HUD overlay elements — REC indicator, 
horizon level, stabilisation lock icon, 4K/120fps badge, battery status. 
Right side vertical feature callout cards in frosted glass dark panels: 
RockSteady 4.0 Ultra Stabilisation, Waterproof 20m Native, Dual Screens, 
10-bit D-Log M Colour. Typography: large condensed white headline 
"EVERY FRAME. PERFECTED." with clean editorial weight, no distressing. 
Bottom CTA strip with DJI grey-to-white gradient accent. 
Overall grade: cool slate tones, deep shadow detail, teal-blue atmosphere, 
sharp contrast highlights. Shot on Phase One, colour graded by colorist 
working on Apple TV originals, retouched by Glassworks London. 
--ar 2:3 --style raw --v 6.1
